summary: The team is executing a China-first global marketing strategy—prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for search/AI visibility—while finalizing the knowledge website redesign and resolving a lingering Outlook lockout that has blocked email access across devices.
summaryDetail: The most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout caused by stale saved passwords; the team must re-login on all devices and confirm the unlock with CKGSB IT before normal communication resumes. In parallel, the knowledge website redesign is nearing completion: the team has agreed to keep the current look and feel, adopt the improved menu categorization, disperse videos by topic, and bring BCI/BSI index banners to the knowledge homepage—Joseph needs to share his HTML file and Joker must implement the feedback after a 30-minute review session. The strategic priority remains the China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for search and AI visibility, with Joseph tasked to draft targeting prompts and profile existing Asia Star participants, and the team still awaiting the GA conversion tracking brief. Looking ahead, the Global Marcom work report and ESG report draft are due in early November, and the team must align on outstanding items for the November 13 event by October 30.

decisions.text: Delete and re-login email accounts on all devices to update passwords
Keep the current knowledge site look and feel rather than a dramatic revamp; menu categorization change is the main improvement.
Remove the standalone videos section and disperse videos by topic instead.
Bring BCI (and BSI) index banners into the knowledge section, similar to the school homepage.
Do not add a stock-market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Use a pinned article top-left with latest articles displayed below to show more content.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China as top two programs; Berkeley as optional third; US programs on hold initially.
Focus first quarter on China programs, with US partnerships benefiting later from built authority.
